description: Search nodes by natural-language query. Uses embedding vectors when an embedder is available (Ollama nomic-embed-text → in-process MiniLM → substring fallback) — phrase the query the way you would describe what you want.

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. "service handling checkout payments"

name: semantic_search
